fields.summary_ko.0: V (Visa Inc.) rose +28.4% over the past year, significantly outpacing the Zacks financial transaction industry average (+10.5%).
fields.summary_ko.1: V benefits from a strong global brand, extensive payment network, growth in digital transactions, international remittances and commercial solutions, and investments in agentic commerce and stablecoins.
fields.summary_ko.2: PFE (Pfizer Inc.) grew +22.8%, underperforming the industry average (+33.7%) over the past year, with concerns about patent expiration risks and revenue pressure from loss of exclusivity on key products.
